Articulated Moxy Operator (FIFO Darwin)  
   
 Are you ready to take the next step in your career and join a high-performing team in the Northern Territory? We are currently seeking an experienced Articulated Moxy Operators for a project that values precision, safety, and operational excellence. If you hold tickets for other mobile plant equipment, we strongly encourage you to apply as well. 
   
  About your new role  
   
 You will be an integral part of the civil crew, responsible for the safe and efficient transport of bulk earthworks across the project site. Your daily contributions will be vital to keeping operations moving and hitting production targets. 
 
  Operate Articulated Moxy safely daily  
  Load and unload bulk materials  
  Maintain accurate machine pre-starts  
  Collaborate with the civil team  
  Adhere to strict safety guidelines  
 
  What you will need to exceed  
   
 To be successful in this position, you must bring a strong commitment to safety and operational efficiency. We are looking for operators who take initiative and work well within a dynamic team environment. 
 
  Minimum 2 years operational experience  
  Current Articulated Moxy ticket required  
  Ability to pass pre-employment medical  
  Valid Australian driver's licence  
  Strong safety and reliability focus  
  Experience in other mobile plant advantageous  
 
  What you will get in return  
   
 You will be working on a premium site that values your rest and wellbeing. 
 
  FIFO roster: 21 days on, 8 days rest - roster changes towards end of 2026  
  Flights from Darwin to site provided  
  Access to gym and pool facilities  
  Competitive hourly rates  
  Supportive and professional team environment  
 
  Note: Interstate applicants are welcome to apply; however, you will be required to cover your own travel expenses to Darwin for FIFO departure.  
   
  Your new company  
   
 You will be joining a well-established project environment known for its high standards and commitment to excellence. The site provides a comfortable lifestyle with excellent accommodation and recreational facilities to help you recharge between shifts. 
   
  Next steps  
   
 If you are ready to hit the ground running, click the 'Apply' button to submit your resume. 
   
 If you have any questions, please contact Vanessa Sands at vanessa.sands@randstad.com.au.
